ORDINANCE # 94-04 AMENDMENT TO ORDINANCE # 93-03 CONTINUANCE OF A NON CONFORMING USE

AN ORDINANCE CLARIFYING NON CONFORMING USE STANDARDS FOR TOWN OF CLERMONT, TO REPEAL ANY CONFLICTING ORDINANCES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES:

INVARIABLY, AT THE TIME AN ORDINANCE IS ADOPTED OR AMENDED, LAND USES WHICH EXISTED PRIOR TO THE ADOPTION OR AMENDMENT WILL NOT CONFORM TO THE USE STANDARDS OR REQUIREMENTS FOR THE PARTICULAR DISTRICT. THESE ARE KNOWN AS NON CONFORMING USE PROPERTIES. IN ORDER TO FEASIBLY ADOPT AN ORDINANCE AND SO AS NOT TO CAUSE UNDUE ECONOMIC HARDSHIP ON OWNERS OF NON- CONFORMING USE PROPERTIES, THESE USES ARE ALLOWED TO CONTINUE UNDER THE REQUIREMENTS OF ARTICLE IV, SECTION 4-2, CONTINUANCE OF A NON CONFORMING USE.
2:
ANY STRUCTURE OR USE OF LAND EXISTING AT THE TIME OF THE ENACTMENT OR SUBSEQUENT AMENDMENT OF THIS ORDINANCE NOT IN CONFORMITY WITH ITS USE REGULATIONS AND PROVISIONS, MAY BE CONTINUED WITH THE FOLLOWING LIMITATIONS: NON-CONFORMING USE SHALL NOT BE:

A. CHANGED (RENTED OR SOLD) TO ANOTHER NON-CONFORMING USE UNLESS THE CHANCE IS SUBMITTED FIRST TO THE PLANNING & ZONING BOARD AND THEN ULTIMATELY TO TOWN COUNCIL FOR FINAL APPROVAL. MOREOVER, APPROVAL IF GRANTED, BY SAID COUNCIL SHALL BE MADE WITHIN A REASONABLE AMOUNT OF TIME AS DEFINED BY THE COUNCIL.

CHANCES IN OWNERSHIP OR TENANCY OF A NON-CONFORMING ‘USE ARE PERMITTED.

B. EXPANDED, ENLARGED OR EXTENDED EXCEPT THAT THE STRUCTURE OR USE IN ITS ENTIRETY BE IN CONFORMANCE WITH THIS ORDINANCE.

C. RE-ESTABLISHED AFTER DISCONTINUANCE FOR (12) MONTHS (EXCEPT BY SPECIAL EXCEPTION OF THE BOARD OF APPEALS) .

D. AS A RESULT OF NATURAL DISASTER (SUCH AS FIRE, FLOOD, TORNADO, ETC), RE-BUILT, ALTERED, OR REPAIRED AFTER DAMAGE EXCEEDING. (50%) FIFTY PERCENT OF THE FAIR SALES (MARKET) VALUE OF THE BUILDING IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE DAMAGE. PERCENT OF THE DAMAGE TO BE DETERMINED BY THE FIRE MARSHALL (EXCEPT BY SPECIAL EXCEPTION OF THE BOARD OF APPEALS).
7:
RESTORED, OR STRENGTHENED FOR THE SAME USE, SUBJECT TO PERMITS REQUIRED.

THE BOARD OF APPEALS (CITY COUNCIL) MAY GRANT THE ENLARGEMENT, CHANGE OR CONTINUANCE OF A NON- CONFORMING USE UPON A FINDING THAT SUCH CHANGE OR ENLARGEMENT IS NECESSARY TO PREVENT AN UNWARRANTED HARDSHIP, AND PROVIDED THAT SUCH CHANGE OR ENLARGEMENT IS IN THE BEST INTEREST OF THE SURROUNDING COMMUNITY AND IN KEEPING WITH THE SPIRIT OF PROPER ZONING AND PLANNING. SUCH FINDING SHALL APPLY TO SPECIFIC PROPERTIES AND SHALL NOT BE APPLIED TO OTHER PROPERTIES IN THE DISTRICT.

ADOPTED REGULATIONS REQUIRE TOWN OF CLERMONT TO REGULATE NON-CONFORMING USE PROPERTIES; AND
